A helper function to decompose a hyperelastic material model and get the underlying deviatoric material model, volumetric material model and their material parameters as a tuple. Here, the material models returned still fulfill Concepts::Material and have also been reduced again if the underlying material model is reduced (vanishing stress or vanishing strain).

simplesect.para: It is to be noted that the volumetric material model returned comes with a material parameter equal to unity. Hence, the volumetric material parameter of the underlying model is also returned separately. This is done to obtain a simple constructor for the DisplacementPressure element.
A tuple containing the deviatoric material model, volumetric material model, deviatoric material parameters and volumetric material parameters.
